description: This file defines the StripeManager class which manages interactions with the Stripe API, including subscription management, product and plan retrieval, customer portal creation, and proration calculations within a server-side application.

classes.name: StripeManager
classes.description: A class that manages Stripe API interactions for subscriptions, products, customer portals, and billing operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of StripeManager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Stripe client with the secret key and sets up the cache manager.

methods.name: getSubscriptionObject
methods.description: Extracts basic subscription details into an object.

methods.name: getProductIdFromSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves the product ID associated with a subscription, using cache if available.

methods.name: getFeaturesByPlan
methods.description: Fetches features associated with a subscription plan, optionally using cache.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates a billing portal session for a customer.

methods.name: getPriceIds
methods.description: Retrieves active price IDs for different user plans and seats.

methods.name: createPortalConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a billing portal configuration with specified features.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of additional seats and included seats for a subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Retrieves customer details including default payment source.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration details for additional seats when changing quantity.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates the number of additional seats and pays the invoice if unpaid.

methods.name: getPlanProration
methods.description: Calculates proration details when changing to a new plan, considering first month free eligibility.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates a subscription to a new plan, applying a free month coupon if eligible, and pays the latest invoice.
